title: vtc-server history: VTCCall, VTCRecording, VTCLivestream
description:
Design: docs/design/object-history.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: H19. Crates: jmap-vtc-types, jmap-vtc-server. Size: M.

Scope per decision 5, confirmed by decision 22 (resolves D1). Spec: object-history-03 §3, §4, §5.1, §8.2; draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00 (VTCLivestream streamKey/streamUri visibility; VTCRecording references blobs). Design: docs/design/object-history.md §5 'Foo/get' step 8, §7, §9 vtc bullet.

Work:
- impl HistoryObject for VtcCall (VTCCall), VTCRecording, VTCLivestream (not VTCParticipant, excluded by decision 22).
- _set_impl split; history handlers for all three, which all have /query.
- register_vtc_handlers_with_history.
- The VTCLivestream streamKey/streamUri blanking (media.rs) is applied to every history entry.
- History reads emit no VTC events; a restore emits what an update would.
- Memory: the event queue stays in Inner; VTCRecording blob rule (decision 6(d)); id minting audited.
- Registry cross-check test.

Acceptance:
- streamKey/streamUri are blanked in every version for a caller who may not see them now.
- A recording whose blob was destroyed ⇒ notFound once destroyed.
- VTCParticipant history flag ⇒ invalidArguments.
- CHANGELOG, public-api.
